infoPlist.NSContactsUsageDescription: 1INME can read your contacts so you can save someone you just met as a contact card from their 1INME profile.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: 1INME records the approximate location of NFC tag writes so you can see where each tag was provisioned. This is optional and only used while the app is open.
infoPlist.NFCReaderUsageDescription: 1INME writes your short link to NFC tags so a tap opens your profile.
infoPlist.NSFaceIDUsageDescription: 1INME uses Face ID so you can unlock the app without re-entering your code.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: 1INME records short voice clips when you tap the mic so the in-app assistant can transcribe what you said and reply by voice.
